gie_001: You can recognise it by its two trunks, the taller running more than ten metres straight up before the first branch, like a column. They stand in the Badenburger Wald, in Wieseck.
gie_002: You can recognise it by the steel grating over a hole in its trunk and a heavy branch propped on steel tubes. It stands at the corner of Geiselweg and Seeweg, in Rödgen.
gie_003: You can recognise it as the modest memorial lime, just under two metres round, planted for Schiller's centenary. It stands on the Geiselstrauchkopf, near the sports field in Rödgen.
gie_004: You can recognise them as the two old, partly hollow limes standing with a younger, newly planted one beside them. They stand at the Lindbach spring source, in Lützellinden.
